title: FieldLayer
description: A georeferenced raster (or vector) analytics product for one field — e.g. Soil Organic Matter, NDVI, biomass — produced by an external service and written to the eVault as a file. Carries the layer type, acquisition date, per-layer statistics, CRS and bounds, and references the raster file blob (fileRef) plus an optional rendered preview. Distinct from Observation (a point/footprint scan with photos): a FieldLayer is a whole-field gridded product.

logicalFieldRef.description: w3ds:// reference to the LogicalField this layer covers.

fieldExternalId.description: The producing service's own field id, when there is no LogicalField ref.

fileRef.description: w3ds:// reference to the raster file blob (e.g. a GeoTIFF).

previewRef.description: Optional w3ds:// reference to a rendered preview (e.g. a coloured PNG).

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of the raster, e.g. EPSG:28992.

bbox.description: Bounds in the raster CRS: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY].

bbox4326.description: Convenience WGS84 bounds [west, south, east, north] for map overlay.

nodata.description: The nodata sentinel value in the raster.
